title: STNFS (lean model) on a theta=87/200 sub-region, exact count products, 2-SE work allowance, alpha_g 0.844, explicit node counter: 2^122.017

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P in G1 (g=e(P,Q0), z=g^a, a recovered by two GT discrete logarithms; Q=infinity iff z=1) with success at least 0.39 under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9); the modelled success is >= 0.391663 (proof.md section 7). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.017 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals <= 2^122.01687. All stated bounds below are rounded in the safe direction and each is checked against the unrounded value by the experiment's declared_bounds check. Relation collection runs on the theta=87/200 uniform sub-region of the package's uniform theta=1/2 pool (1583 of 2401 canonical rows, 1481 primitive), with the exact products of the certified per-region lattice-count bounds at every radius >= 955 (yield factor 0.973693682 rounded down from the exact product, work factor 1.025422386 rounded up) instead of blanket brackets, and the sampled work mean is charged with an explicit canonical-work allowance 1.0549 >= 1 + 2.00 x SE where the incidence-inclusive relative standard error of the total-work estimator is SE <= 2.745%, computed from the row contributions in [4a]; the allowance is a declared H2 modeling margin for a fixed challenge-independent quantity, not a probability term. Relation collection charges Murphy alpha (5, 0.844), above the in-package computed (4.868096, 0.545620) over p <= 2000 ([14]); the descent keeps (5, 1). The f/g ECM cofactor slacks are 298/229 bits with the per-survivor ECM charged by the package's explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% per prime. Retained yield is >= 2^64.1319, at least 0.302 bits above 1.3 U and above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor; relation collection is <= 2^121.5619 units. The descent's missing-log input is LOG2_RELS = 64.131 and its mean-norm inputs 748.3/498.9 bits, each at or below the sub-region model's values (checked in [4]); with the 62-node plan (five entries re-optimised for these inputs under mu >= 16, phi <= 0.05, psi <= 0.8) and boot (215,43,15,4) the two-log expectation is <= 2^118.1226 units and the instruction meter cap is 2^118.845 units, so Markov gives P(cap reached) <= 0.6060858. An explicit special-q node counter aborts the run (counted as failure) beyond N_MAX = 2^27.3 nodes, so at most 2^27.3 nodes run by construction; E[N] <= 2^17.66 by the work recurrence with unit node cost (counts16.py), so P(counter abort) <= 2^-9.64 by Markov, and special-q repeats among at most N_MAX nodes are <= 2^-10.70; boot failure is <= 1.9830e-04 per log. No per-node work lower bound is used. Linear algebra uses block Wiedemann with blocks (26,5), per-entry charges 88/97 and pad 1.61 (<= 2^119.3685 units). Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.017 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=87/200 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius >= 955, the incidence-inclusive total-work standard error and the charged 2.00-SE allowance (1.0549), the ledger, filtering, the block-Wiedemann parameters, the descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, the expected special-q node count (counts16.py) with the node-counter and repeat terms, toys and audit, the in-package Murphy alpha check [14]; checks every stated bound against its unrounded value (declared_bounds); prints total_log2W_full_ledger, work_se, modelled_success and within_claim.
